title: the version line drops ' at <root>' (contract A3, hv's ruling): devbin <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty]), readers read to the closing parenthesis
body:
## The problem

hv ruled on 2026-10-25 that ` at <root>` comes off the version line: "That info is idiotic. Why would that ever be necessary when you can just type of which it!?" The dev/opt/brew contract's amendment A3 (agreed by every tool that signs it) changes T4 to match: the line is `<tool> <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`, it names no path because `command -v <tool>` answers where the running copy lives, and a reader of the line reads up to the closing parenthesis and ignores anything after it.

devbin's line still ends ` at <root>` (lib/helpers, the one tree-line function), and `use`, doctor, the help pages and several tests print or pin that tail.

## Done when

1. `devbin --version`, `devbin version`, `use`'s report and doctor print `devbin <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`, and `devbin <version> (dev, unknown)` when the dev tree's git cannot be read. The one tree-line function makes the change, and no caller adds a path back.
2. Doctor names a path only where a check that fails is about one (eg the shadow check naming what shadows the link).
3. Every reader of a version line in devbin reads up to the closing parenthesis and ignores the rest, so a line in the old shape still reads correctly. No reader carries a second format.
4. docs/dev-opt-brew.md carries A3 in T4: the line, the unknown form, the sentence that the line names no path, the reader rule, and a compiled tool's provenance word placed directly after the parenthesis. The sentences on `<root>` are removed. lib/pages and docs that show the line show the new shape.
5. Every test that pins the ` at <root>` tail is rewritten to the new shape, not kept beside it. One arm checks the reader rule against an old-shape line.
6. Arms: red on 593109bf first, then green, BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and the critic leg. The full suite is green.

## Resolution

Fixed at 40663691 (contract amendment A3), landed on landing suite 20261026-0642 at 261286d6, beside the public candidate's suite 20261026-0652: in both, every test ran and passed, the only skips were the standing environmental ones, and the errors seal was empty. cc built it in a scratch clone, and vc landed it.

- **Done when 1.** `devbin_tree_line` (lib/helpers), the one function that prints the line, prints `devbin <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`, and `devbin <version> (dev, unknown)` when the dev tree's git cannot be read. `--version`, `version`, `use`'s report and doctor all print it through that function, and none adds a path back. `install_named_root` stays, since the dispatcher's install hint and shell-init still name an install by it.
- **Done when 2.** Doctor's install row and tree row print the line with no path. The switch rows that still name a path are about one: the shadow check, a link that leads to no devbin tree, and an install in the manifest form from before the tree line, a fail for opt and a note for a keg.
- **Done when 3.** `tree_line_head` (lib/helpers) is T4's reader rule: a line is read up to and including its first closing parenthesis, and the rest is ignored. Doctor's tree check reads its line through it. No other code in devbin reads a version line: the one other `--version` read, in bats-lanes, reads GNU parallel's. The release core's note back to brew printed `--version reads (brew, <sha12>) at <version>`, which looked like the old tail; it now prints the whole line, `<formula> <version> (brew, <sha12>)`.
- **Done when 4.** docs/dev-opt-brew.md T4 carries A3 as agreed: the line, the unknown form, the sentence that the line names no path, the reader rule, and the provenance word placed after the parenthesis. The sentences on `<root>` are removed. lib/pages/use.md, lib/pages/release.md and docs/releasing.md show the new shape.
- **Done when 5.** The arms that pinned the tail are rewritten to the new shape, none kept beside it: use (the opt report's line, whole), localinstall (every spelling of the version question, whole), machinepointer (doctor's install row, with no `' at '`), dispatch (the dev line, ending at the parenthesis) and releasecut (the note back to brew, in both forms). A use.bats arm reads an old-shape line, a provenance word and the new shape through `tree_line_head`. fullcycle, clean and autotests carry `' at '` text that is not the line, and pin nothing of it.
- **Done when 6.** Red on 593109bf (v0.1.14): each changed and new arm fails there. The releasecut pair would fail there regardless, since 0228's note is not in that release. Green, each arm alone, BSD and GNU. Targeted run under molt-vc's GO LIGHT of 2026-10-25 15:49Z, at the wip whose tree the squash keeps (fb52b314): the changed arms' files, the files that read the line beside them (releasecore, doctor, install, shellinit), the tree scans and help, each file on its own, every file green on BSD and on GNU, rc 0, ended 16:51Z. fullcycle, autotests and clean run cargo and pin nothing of the line, so land220's landing suite carries them. Critic leg: `intent critic shell --files <each changed file>` from the repo root, rc 0, no shell finding at severity warning or above.
